description: Real distributed NCCL results on 4×RTX3090 pod (RunPod), post-warmup timing. Warmup run executed before each timed run to exclude NCCL initialization (~1.3s) from measurement.
hardware: 4× NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3090 (24 GB each), PCIe-connected (no NVLink), CUDA 12.4, PyTorch 2.4.0

strong_scaling.note: Communication-bound: all_reduce latency (~5ms warm) dominates compute for n=1000

weak_scaling.description: n_nodes = base_n × world_size, each GPU processes base_n=500 nodes
weak_scaling.note: ws=2 achieves near-ideal weak scaling (99%); ws=4 reduces to 43% due to PCIe all_reduce overhead

estimate_consistency.note: All world sizes produce statistically indistinguishable estimates, confirming distributed correctness

first_run_timing.description: Cold start timing (includes ~1.3s NCCL initialization on first all_reduce)
